about: IRB Infrastructure Developers Limited engages in the infrastructure development in India. It operates through Built, Operate and Transfer (BOT)/Toll, Operate and Transfer (TOT); InvITs & Related Assets; and Construction segments. The company is involved in the operation and maintenance of roads; airport development; development of highways; investment in units of IRB Infrastructure Trust, IRB InvIT Fund, and other related assets; and real estate activities.
